title.value: The Message Log admin grid lists a real ordo_message_log row

description.value: Controller/Adminhtml/MessageLog/Index.php (Marketing -> Ordo Automation -> Message Log) had no MFTF coverage at all - missed by SCENARIOS.md's own scope check (which only enumerated 7 admin areas; ContentBlock and MessageLog were added later and never folded in). ordo_message_log is written only by a real send_sms campaign action (which needs a real Twilio account this environment doesn't have, see ROADMAP.md) or the delivery-status webhook, so MessageLogTestHelper inserts a row directly via SQL - same reasoning as OfferTestHelper/OrderBackdateHelper for their own tables. The grid itself IS a real admin UI component page, driven for real here.
